interpretation.first_n: Use first N original sources in row-major order, preserving all original markers.
interpretation.color_quota: Use first 1 + ((source color - 1) mod 3) original sources.
interpretation.fixed_color_1: Paint new cells color 1; preserve original sources.
interpretation.source_orthogonal: Only original-source orthogonal rays, with no boundary reflection.
interpretation.row_column_extremal: Launch only from markers extremal within both their occupied row and occupied column; preserve all markers.
interpretation.row_extremal: Launch only from leftmost/rightmost markers within each occupied row; preserve all markers.
interpretation.column_extremal: Launch only from topmost/bottommost markers within each occupied column; preserve all markers.
interpretation.setting_both_for_one_bounce: Also exactly the rival that uses original sources instead of boundary endpoints for anti rays.
interpretation.skip_a: Compute the endpoints but omit painting main-axis stage A; preserve original markers.
interpretation.painted_sources: Recompute stage B sources from every nonzero cell after stage A.
interpretation.two_bounces: After normal one-bounce rays, reflect once more from their anti-axis endpoints onto main-axis rays; frozen at each stage.

limits: Finite named geometric rivals and two seeds; not universal rule uniqueness.
Rivals refuted by demonstrations need no query labels; every survivor is checked on all four queries.
All 10 bank inputs per seed/setting have protected labels, including 7x7 and substantial 30x30 grids.
The bounded extra-reflection rival tests two bounces, not arbitrary recursive closure.
Racket errors and Python/Racket disagreements abort rather than count as refutations.
